# SIGMA VI — Top-40 Selection: Implementation Plan

Implements [`SELECTION_SPEC.md`](SELECTION_SPEC.md) under the project's **$0 constraint**. Written
2026-10-07. Every data claim below was checked against the provider's own documentation that day.

**What the system produces.** A ranked research output generated by a stated, tested method. It is
not personal financial advice. Every number in the final report comes from code; every claim carries
a source and a date.

---

## 1. What the free data can and cannot support

| Spec requirement | Free source | Coverage | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| Whole-market universe incl. delisted | SEC submissions (tickers, exchanges, SIC) + Massive reference tickers (`active=false` for delisted) | all SEC filers; NYSE/NASDAQ/NYSE American flags | ✅ |
| Point-in-time fundamentals | SEC `companyfacts.zip`, nightly bulk file of every XBRL fact with its `filed` date and accession number | 2009 onward (XBRL mandate), every filer | ✅ the backbone of the screen |
| Daily prices, whole market | Massive "grouped daily": one call = every US stock for one day | free plan: 2 years, 5 calls/min → ~500 calls ≈ 2 hours, once | ✅ for the last 2 years |
| Longer price history (backtests) | Alpaca free market data, 7+ years, 200 calls/min | IEX feed only: partial volume, thin small caps | ⚠️ needs a free Alpaca account; small-cap prices flagged |
| Delisted-stock prices before 2 years ago | Alpaca coverage of inactive symbols not guaranteed | — | ⚠️ survivorship bias measured and reported, not assumed away |
| Corporate actions, dividends | Massive (free) | full | ✅ |
| Macro and regimes | FRED / ALFRED vintages | decades | ✅ |
| Analyst estimates and revisions, **history** | none free | — | ❌ revisions **cannot be backtested**; SIGMA archives estimates from now on |
| Analyst estimates, **current** (deep-research names) | Alpha Vantage, 25 requests/day | ~20 names/day | ✅ for the final 100–150 only |
| Transcripts, presentations, guidance | Alpha Vantage transcripts; Exa → company IR pages and SEC exhibits | per company | ✅ for deep research |
| Short interest, institutional ownership | Alpha Vantage (limited calls) | deep-research names only | ⚠️ |
| Benchmarks | ETF proxies: SPY, QQQ, IWB (Russell 1000), IWM (Russell 2000), RSP (equal-weight) | price history | ✅ |
| Simulations (≥1M paths) | local compute | unlimited | ✅ |
| 20-agent committee, 100–150 companies | Gemini free tier + local models | rate-limited | ✅ slow: days of runtime, not minutes |

**Consequences, stated up front:**

1. **Backtest window ≈ 2016–2026**, longer if Alpaca's history allows. It covers the 2018 drawdown,
   the 2020 COVID crash, the 2020–21 speculative run, the 2022 inflation and rate shock, and the
   2023–25 recovery. It **does not** include 2000–02 or 2008–09, so crisis behaviour is studied
   through the simulation engine's stress generators, not through history.
2. **Earnings-revision factors stay EXPERIMENTAL.** They can inform deep research on current names,
   but the methodology cannot claim they were validated. This is exactly the limitation the spec asks
   to be named rather than hidden.
3. **Small caps compete, but on stricter data terms.** A stock needs enough price and volume history
   to be priced and traded realistically; otherwise it is flagged "insufficient information quality"
   (spec: Investable Universe).

## 2. The funnel, mapped to code

```
Stage 1–3   UNIVERSE + CHEAP SCREEN          code only, whole market (~4–6k names)  → 300–500
            sigma.universe, sigma.factors     factors from companyfacts + prices
Stage 4–5   SECONDARY SCORE                  code only                               → 100–150
            sigma.scoring (provisional weights = spec table, as hypotheses)
Stage 6–9   DEEP RESEARCH + MODELS           agents on Gemini/local, numbers from code
            sigma.agents (20 roles), sigma.finance (DCF, reverse DCF, scenarios)
Stage 10–11 ADVERSARIAL COMMITTEE            8 rounds + pairwise tournament + Red Team → ~60
            sigma.research.debate
Stage 12–20 VALIDATION OF THE *QUANT* LAYER   PIT backtest, walk-forward, holdout, ablation,
            sigma.backtesting, sigma.simulation   randomization, ±5/10/20% perturbation, ≥1M paths
Stage 21–26 APPLY FROZEN MODEL → FINAL 40    report, weights, watchlist 41–60, audit
```

**The split between the two layers matters.** Only the *systematic* layer (factor screen and score)
can be backtested: there is no point-in-time record of what 20 LLM agents would have concluded in
2018, and simulating one with today's models would leak hindsight. So:

- The **factor model** is developed on train data, tuned on validation, frozen, and scored once on
  the holdout. Its weights become the SIGMA Score's quantitative core.
- The **agent committee** works only on today's shortlist. It can veto or adjust within bounds, but
  its contribution is labelled "not historically validated", and the paper-trading record is where
  it earns trust (forecast calibration, VALIDATION.md §8).

## 3. Factor library (Stage 2 screen), all computable from free PIT data

| Family | Factors (each as level, trend, and sector-relative rank) |
|---|---|
| Growth | revenue, EPS, FCF, EBITDA growth (YoY, 3-yr CAGR); acceleration |
| Profitability | gross, operating, FCF margin; ROIC, ROE, ROA; incremental margin |
| Financial health | net debt/EBITDA, interest coverage, current ratio, FCF coverage of debt |
| Cash-flow quality | CFO/NI, accruals ratio, SBC/revenue, capex intensity, receivables and inventory vs sales growth |
| Capital allocation | share count change (dilution or buybacks), acquisition spend |
| Valuation | EV/EBITDA, EV/FCF, FCF yield, EV/Sales, P/E, valuation vs own 5-yr range, vs sector |
| Market | 12-1 momentum, relative strength vs sector, volatility, liquidity (ADV), max drawdown |
| Revisions | **current only** (EXPERIMENTAL, excluded from the validated core) |

Normalization: winsorize at 1/99%, z-score within sector each rebalance date. Sector-neutral and
raw variants are both tested (spec: "sector adjustment" may evolve).

## 4. Validation protocol (Stages 12–20)

As in VALIDATION.md, with these spec-specific settings:

- **Splits:** train 2016–2020, validation 2021–2023, **holdout 2024-01 → latest**, sealed until the
  methodology is frozen. Walk-forward inside train+validation with a 1-year step.
- **Portfolio rule under test:** top 40 by score, rebalanced monthly or quarterly (tested), equal
  weight and conviction weight both reported.
- **Costs:** optimistic / base / pessimistic presets; strategy must stay positive under pessimistic.
- **Ablation:** drop one factor family at a time; drop a family that doesn't earn its complexity.
- **Randomization:** ≥5,000 random 40-stock portfolios matched on sector, size, liquidity and
  volatility; report SIGMA's percentile and p-value.
- **Stability:** perturb weights ±5/10/20%; report the performance surface, penalize cliffs.
- **Regimes:** results split by rate direction, inflation level, volatility tercile and market trend
  (FRED-labelled, VALIDATION.md §5.3).
- **Simulations:** ≥1,000,000 paths fed with *out-of-sample* returns only; convergence reported.
- **Benchmarks:** SPY, QQQ, IWB, IWM, RSP, plus simple momentum, quality, value and growth top-40
  portfolios built from the same data. If a simple one matches SIGMA, SIGMA adopts the simple one.
- **Multiple-testing ledger:** every variant tried is logged; deflated Sharpe uses that count.

## 5. Build order

| # | Milestone | Runs on | Output you can see |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Universe: SEC + Massive tickers, exchange and quality filters | your PC | universe table in Neon, counts by exchange and size |
| B | Fundamentals: `companyfacts.zip` → normalized PIT facts | your PC (~1 GB download, nightly refresh) | coverage report |
| C | Prices: Massive grouped daily (2 yrs) + Alpaca (7+ yrs, if keys) | your PC | price coverage report |
| D | Factor engine + **provisional screen** (spec weights, unvalidated) | your PC | first ranked list, clearly labelled EXPERIMENTAL |
| E | PIT backtester, walk-forward, ablation, randomization, perturbation | your PC | methodology report v1 |
| F | Simulation engine (≥1M paths) | your PC | simulation report |
| G | Freeze model → single holdout run | your PC | out-of-sample result |
| H | Agents + 8-round committee + tournament + Red Team on the shortlist | your PC (Gemini + local) | dossiers, debate records |
| I | Final 40, weights, watchlist 41–60, portfolio analysis, audit | — | the SIGMA VI report |

A provisional list (milestone D) comes long before a validated one (G and I). It will be labelled as
such, and it is the starting point the validation is designed to beat or discard.
